method: Built-in image generation; temporary fictional editorial scenes

prompts.name: arrive
prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one square editorial photograph for Tavyora's quiet online yoga practice website, no text, logo or drawn lines. Fictional adults, never actual customers or practitioner. Consistent four-scene art direction: warm bone plaster wall, pale matte limestone floor, subtle wall/floor seam, soft natural window daylight from frame left, muted oatmeal/stone/charcoal breathable clothing, real skin and linen texture, natural soft shadows. Camera at seated chest height, 50mm normal lens, calm level framing, full human bodies with generous head/foot margins, people occupy central 65% of frame with negative space on both sides. Home-like quiet room fragment, minimal staging, one muted textile mat. Not transparent cutouts. No visible windows needed, no decor, plants, spiritual objects or fitness gear. Restrained low contrast but clear natural faces. Not spa, sunset, studio stock photo, glamorous fitness, perfect athletic bodies, artificial glow, forced smile, advanced yoga or dramatic flexibility. One South Asian woman approximately 40 years old, ordinary non-athletic body, seated comfortably on a simple low cushion, hands relaxed on thighs, gaze softly downward, neutral quiet arrival posture. Figure slightly left of centre.
